mapper.select: select rac.id, racd.id as detailId, rac.code, ra.type, rac.source_type as sourceType, rac.approve_status as approveStatus, rac.source_code as sourceCode, rac.source_id as sourceId, rac.business_id as businessId, rac.business_code as businessCode, rac.invalid_status as invalidStatus, rac.approve_time as approveTime, rac.approve_user_id as approveUserId, rac.approve_user_name as approveUserName, rac.approve_status as approveStatus, rac.create_time as createTime, rac.create_user_name as createUserName, racd.platform_sku_no as platformSku, racd.platform_sku_name as platformSkuName, racd.sku_id as skuId, racd.sku_no as skuNo, racd.fn_sku as fnSku, racd.platform_spu as asin, racd.origin_qty as originRequisitionQty, racd.new_qty as newRequisitionQty, racd.change_type as changeType from requisition_application_change rac inner join requisition_application_change_detail racd on rac.id = racd.main_id and racd.is_deleted = false inner join requisition_application ra on ra.id = rac.business_id and ra.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and rac.is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY rac.id DESC
select approve_status, count(id) from requisition_application_change where is_deleted = false group by approve_status

select racd.* from requisition_application_change rac inner join requisition_application_change_detail racd on rac.id = racd.main_id and racd.is_deleted = false where rac.approve_status !='approve' and rac.is_deleted = false and rac.invalid_status = false and racd.business_detail_id in
#{item}
